text:
maria: Quick idea — run a 1-week tone-testing sprint for the competitive battlecard vs cloud AI platforms / LLM APIs. Test empathetic product-first vs technical performance-first language.
aj: yes please. we keep losing to 'managed convenience' messaging. want concrete hooks for infra/platform buyers.
lucy_pm: Goal: two short battlecard variants, 1-pager each, and 3 call scripts for SDRs. Also a 5-min webinar explainer for benchmarks.
dylan_sales: needs crisp rebuttals to "we're easiest to integrate" and "lowest ops cost" claims. examples please.
sam_k: suggest A/B subject lines for the webinar invite:
- "How to cut inference cost 3x without sacrificing latency"
- "Serving LLMs in production: Predictable performance, not guesswork"
maria: love those. let's map claims -> proof points. e.g., "predictable latency" -> SLA numbers + dedicated pools + autoscale policy snippet.
aj: for bench narrative we should avoid raw FLOPS talk. focus on p99 latency under mixed workloads and cost per 1M tokens.
lucy_pm: can someone draft the short PR/launch post copy? two tones: human-first and engineer-first. 3 variants each.
dylan_sales: add a quick one-liner for calls: "We help teams move from unpredictable inference bills to predictable per-feature cost."
sam_k: ops-bot: bump — /deploy-playbook link for webinar landing page
ops-bot: @channel landing page template deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar/tone-test
maria: ok action items:
- sam_k: two webinar subject lines + 1 email A/B
- lucy_pm: two 1-page battlecards (empathetic vs technical)
- aj: bench narrative + 2 supporting charts (p99 latency, tokens/second)
- dylan_sales: 3 SDR scripts + rebuttals
- sam_k: create sample demo script for 8-min webinar
Deadline: EOD next Thu. Quick sync on Wed 11am.
aj: I'll do the p99 charts using the new telemetry export. quick note: use anonymized customer traces.
lucy_pm: sample empathetic opener (draft):
"Teams move fast. When your LLM calls slow or spike bills, it's the feature that breaks — not the model. Redwood gives predictable inference so your product teams ship with confidence."
maria: sample tech opener (draft):
"Continuous batching, KV cache, and model-aware kernels combine to deliver consistent p99 latency across mixed workloads. Here's how we measure it."
dylan_sales: these are gold. i'll loop in SDRs for voice testing.
sam_k: will create the invite A/B and schedule the landing page tests.
maria: :thumbsup: let's keep copy <150 words for social posts. don't overclaim. cite benchmark methods in notes.
aj: noted — i'll add a short methods appendix and link to eval harness in the landing page.
maria: great — thanks team. quick check: any legal flags? lucy_pm can you ping legal if needed.
lucy_pm: will do. tagging legal in the doc when drafts are ready.
